propositions: transition_issue_by_name matches destination status names against transition names instead of transition destination statuses, causing lookup failures on workflows where those differ
when a status name fails to match any transition name, a ValueError is caught silently and recorded as bridge_alerts, allowing the pass to exit 0 without applying the status change
some statuses sync successfully (when transition name and destination status name coincide) while others silently fail, appearing as a flaky or partial bridge rather than a systematic mapping defect
the fix resolves names by preferring exact transition-name matches first, then falling back to destination status matches (to.name), and raises on ambiguous destinations or unresolvable names
